data.title: Altissima
data.about:
Discover the pinnacle of eco-friendly luxury at Altissima Al Barari, a jewel in Dubai's crown. Inspired by the enchanting 'tree of heaven', this green paradise is the last chapter in the Al Barari saga, setting a new standard in sustainable living. 

Each of the magical 7-bedroom villas at Altissima Al Barari has been meticulously designed to offer an unrivaled blend of elegance and environmental consciousness. As a resident, you'll enjoy a life of unparalleled luxury and wellness, surrounded by lush landscapes and tranquil waterways. Altissima Al Barari is not just a place to stay; it's a lifestyle. Crafted for individuals seeking a comprehensive and sustainable lifestyle, this botanical sanctuary effortlessly harmonizes the elements of nature with opulent living. It serves as a haven where you can play, work, dine and shop.

Residents can maintain their active lifestyle at Altissima, thanks to the four Padel Courts, a Bowling Alley, Billiards, and Table Tennis in the complex. They can enjoy some pampering at the world-class retreat featuring massage rooms, saunas, ice baths, pools, hammams, full-service hair, and much more. Alternatively, sip a delicious cup of coffee at the cozy Café.

This verdant retreat in the heart of Dubai offers everything from shopping and dining to leisure and work opportunities, all within an eco-conscious and wellness-enhancing environment. Al Barari, meaning 'wilderness' in Arabic, is a trailblazer in integrated luxury and sustainable development.

characteristics_module.title: Your Home to Adore at Altissima Al Barari
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Leisure and Wellness: Alfresco dining, award-winning spa, health club, and a 6 km cycling track.
  • Community Events: Regular activities fostering community spirit.
  • Beach Lagoon: Unique beach experience within the community.
  • Eco-Friendly Living: Set in lush greenery, promoting a sustainable lifestyle.
  • Premium Amenities: Access to exclusive health club, restaurant, and spa.
  • Entertainment and Services: Seve.nth Heaven offers diverse dining and retail options.
  • Prime Location: 15 minutes from Downtown Dubai and close to top schools and hospitals.
  • Greenest Community in Dubai: Award-winning, eco-friendly luxury development.
  • Desirable Address: A blend of luxury and nature, offering a unique living experience.

location_tile.title: Experience Tranquility and Comfort Right in the Heart of the City
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Altissima is located in the popular community of Al Barari. Situated just 15 minutes away from Dubai's iconic landmarks, such as the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah, Al Barari seamlessly blends urban accessibility with the tranquility of nature. This oasis offers a perfect balance, making it an ideal haven for those seeking the conveniences of city life and the soothing embrace of the natural world.

Experience the epitome of upscale living in Al Barari, where each property is a testament to the community's commitment to creating an environment that seamlessly integrates with the surrounding natural landscape. Nestled strategically near the city, the eco-friendly development is over 15.3 million square feet. It boasts themed gardens, landscaped lakes, and freshwater streams.

  • Dubai Airport - 15 Mins
  • City Hospital - 15 Mins
  • Burj Khalifa - 16 Mins
  • Emirates Hills - 18 Mins
  • Palm Jumeirah - 22 Mins
